activities.context_id: Polymorphic: points at event requests, projects, collections, etc. depending on the activity type. A FK can only target one table.
email_messages.context_id: Polymorphic: id of whichever entity the email is about. A FK can only target one table.
expenses.context_id: Polymorphic: event_requests.id or projects.id depending on the expense. A FK can only target one table.
kudos_tracking.context_id: Polymorphic: id of the project/task/event the kudos is for. A FK can only target one table.
messages.context_id: Polymorphic: id of the entity a message thread is attached to. A FK can only target one table.
notifications.related_id: Polymorphic: id of whatever record the notification is about. A FK can only target one table.
notification_action_history.related_id: Polymorphic: id of whatever record the notification action touched. A FK can only target one table.
audit_logs.record_id: Polymorphic: paired with audit_logs.table_name. A FK can only target one table.
user_issue_reports.record_id: Polymorphic: paired with user_issue_reports.record_type. A FK can only target one table.
search_analytics.result_id: Polymorphic: id of whichever search result was clicked (any entity type).
audit_logs.session_id: express-session id kept for forensics. Sessions expire and are purged; the log row must outlive them.
user_activity_logs.session_id: express-session id kept for analytics. Sessions expire and are purged; the log row must outlive them.
client_error_logs.session_id: express-session id kept for debugging. Sessions expire and are purged; the log row must outlive them.
document_access_logs.session_id: express-session id kept for access auditing. Sessions expire and are purged; the log row must outlive them.
event_requests.external_id: External id from Google Sheets, used for duplicate prevention on import.
imported_external_ids.external_id: External id from Google Sheets or other import sources.
tracked_calendar_items.external_id: External calendar source id, used for upserts.
event_requests.google_sheet_row_id: Row identifier in the Event Requests Google Sheet, not a database row.
projects.google_sheet_row_id: Row identifier in a Google Sheet, not a database row.
archived_projects.google_sheet_row_id: Row identifier in a Google Sheet, not a database row.
stream_users.stream_user_id: Stream Chat's own user id (external service).
stream_channels.channel_id: Stream Chat's own channel id (external service).
stream_messages.stream_message_id: Stream Chat's own message id (external service).
stream_threads.stream_thread_id: Stream Chat's own thread id (external service).
dashboard_documents.document_id: References an entry in the adminDocuments array in client code, not a database table.
